Name: Marnie Sells Auto-Petter
Author: hungryraccoon
Description:
I just got my fourth and last Auto-Petter from the Skull Caverns in Year 5 Spring. I'm tired of grinding Skull Caverns or Dangerous Mines for the Auto-Petter and I won't sell my soul to Joja just to get Auto-Petters easily. Solution: Marnie will sell Auto-Petters after the player has seen the Community Center completion ceremony.

I've set the price at 75k gold which is a whopping 50% higher than JojaMart's price to make it feel fair(?)
